name: Multi-Tenant Enterprise Architecture
description: Isolated multi-tenant SaaS foundation with tenant subdomain routing, strict row-level security (RLS) or schema-per-tenant isolation, and tenant-scoped auth.

clarifying_questions.question: Data isolation architecture?
options: Shared database with Row-Level Security (PostgreSQL RLS)
clarifying_questions.impacts: Sets up PostgreSQL RLS policies or dynamic tenant connection pooling

clarifying_questions.question: Tenant resolution method?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Configures tenant resolution middleware and CORS policy

known_failure_modes: Forgetting WHERE tenant_id = :id on custom SQL queries causing catastrophic cross-tenant data leaks — use PostgreSQL RLS as a database-enforced safeguard
Improper caching in Redis where keys lack tenant prefix resulting in cross-tenant cache contamination
Wildcard SSL certificate misconfiguration for customer subdomains
